purpose: Reflect explicit owner decisions from append-only Decision Memory into Proposal Work Queue states, including deterministic retirement of resolved decision-bound cases, without creating production mutation or execution authority.

semantics.approvedMeans: owner-approved for bounded next-stage research/build-candidate work only
semantics.approvedDoesNotMean: production mutation, merge, release, wallet action, signing, transaction, or capital execution
semantics.effectiveDecisionIdentity: latest non-superseded append-only decision for the stable caseKey
semantics.inactiveCaseRetirement: If a decision-bound source case is no longer active in current Learning, the Proposal becomes SUPERSEDED historical memory while retaining the exact owner Decision binding.
semantics.supersededDoesNotMean: rejected, released, executed, or that the original owner decision was erased
